Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.

Sri Santosh Kumar, Advocate has filed short counter affidavit alongwith the vakalatnama on
behalf of the opposite party No. 2 today in Court, which is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Bakhteyar Yusuf, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Santosh Kumar, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the Charge Sheet No. 190 of 2023 dated 12.7.2023 and cognizance order dated 11.8.2023 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 7189 of 2023 (State of U.P. Vs. Julfkar Ali and others) arising out of Case Crime No.188 of 2023, under Sections 376, 354, 342, 498A, 323, 504, 506, 427 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act,
P.S.-Kotwali Nagar, District-Hameerpur, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Hameerpur.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is brother-in-law (devar) of the complainant, who has stated herself as victim of matrimonial cruelty.

The present criminal case was instituted against the applicant and three accused persons, however with the intervention of the respected members of both the family and well-wishers, the parties have amicably and genuinely settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against each other.

Inasmuch as the said criminal case has already been quashed in respect of co-accused Julfkar Ali,
the husband of the victim as well as her parents-in-law whereas the compromise has already been affected between the complainant and all the accused persons including present applicant.

Therefore, the case of applicant is also liable to be disposed of in terms of the said compromise, a copy thereof has been annexed as Annexure No.10 to the application, as no useful purpose of law to be served, if the case is kept pending with regard to present applicant.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submitted that the complainant had accepted the fact before the court below by way of affidavit that she had lodged the FIR against accused persons including present applicant, being mislead by some family members in order to exert pressure on accused persons, who are her husband and in-laws and now good sense has prevailed on her and she is not inclined to proceed with the case any further.

A copy of final order dated 19.12.2023, passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Application U/S 482 No.42839 of 2023 (Julfkar Ali and 2 others vs. State of UP and Another) has been produced before the court for perusal.

entities.text: S 482 No.42839 of 2023 (Julfkar Ali and 2 others vs. State of UP and Another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant has lastly submitted that in view of the compromise made between the parties and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between them, entire proceedings be quashed against the applicant.

7. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has also appeared and has filed an affidavit on behalf of opposite party No. 2 and in paragraph-7 of the said affidavit, the said compromise has been acknowledged.

In paragraph-11, it has been further stated that opposite party No. 2 and co-accused Julfkar now are living together as husband and wife alongwith other family members and leading a happy married life.
In paragraph-12, it has been further stated that the proceedings be dropped.
Counsel for the opposite party No. 2 has further stated, on instruction, that opposite party No. 2 has no objection if the entire proceedings are quashed.
8. Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

9. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of :-
1. B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
2. Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008) 9 SCC 677].

Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another [2013 (83)
ACC 278], in which the law expounded by the Apex court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

sentences.text: 10. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, the court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose shall be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned case.

11. Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Case No. 7189 of 2023 (State of U.P. Vs. Julfkar Ali and others) arising out of Case Crime No.188 of 2023, under Sections 376, 354, 342, 498A, 323, 504,
506, 427 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.-Kotwali Nagar, District-Hameerpur, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hameerpur, are hereby quashed.
